title: How Language Models Conflate Logical Validity with Plausibility: A Representational Analysis of Content Effects

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on syllogistic reasoning tasks where the logical validity of the argument conflicts with the real-world plausibility of the conclusion. The bias is quantified using a Content Effect (CE) metric, and the underlying mechanism is analyzed by extracting and comparing linear steering vectors (difference-in-means) for the concepts of 'validity' and 'plausibility' in the models' latent space.
